scope: The ten selected accepted formal specifications have complete general conditional proofs and meaningful checked model applications/reuse. Full live-deployment compliance is outside this verdict.

closed_findings.basis: Complete nonempty key-interface models prove the technical step/event/history/inventory/policy premises, and exhibit reachable provisioning, signing and protected-copy digest use. Actual K02 implementation correspondence and K01 readable-key violation remain explicit.

Complete blocking and disabled-feature cases use a nonempty feature inventory. Vendor TCP traffic is represented; unrelated protected ESP is accepted; rule and feature mutations fail the intended conditions.

The same unchanged general theorem is used by materially different complete applications for every selected RG. Added management-free topology, common IP/L2 addressing, central-site EAP key-generation and selected-assurance AW examples. Compiled body dependency paths independently checked.

conditions: Physical protection, authority approvals, complete actual observations, and implementation-to-model correspondence remain explicitly named conditions. No actual K02 no-export guarantee or comprehensive vendor-service audit is inferred.
stopping_action: Stop proof construction and review; deliver the validated candidate to the canonical workspace and verify integration. Do not resume the other fourteen RGs.
